prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply computer science methods to the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstraction skills, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of theoretical computer science

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise tasks (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise tasks

assessment_rules: Grading is based on 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise tasks and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise tasks. The examination performance consists of either a written exam or an individual oral examination.
